options.name: name
options.description: The credential name to embed in the encrypted credential data.

options.name: not_after
options.description: The time when the credential shall not be used anymore. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in V(systemd.time(7\)).

options.name: pretty
options.description: Pretty print the output so that it may be pasted directly into a unit file.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: The timestamp to embed into the encrypted credential. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in V(systemd.time(7\)).

options.name: user
options.description: A user name or numeric UID to encrypt the credential for. If set to the special string V(self) it sets the user to the user of the calling process. Requires C(systemd) 256 or later.
